topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining its main objectives and learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor viruses and experimental cell transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms of oncogenic and tumor suppressor mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the categories of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate their biochemical consequences in cell cycle control and p53 regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Multi-step tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how stepwise mutation accumulation and inherited genetic defects accelerate cancer development.

topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks and recommended reading.
